from requests.utils import get_netrc_auth
import tempfile

def test_netrc_cases():
    cases = [
        ("Empty entry", "machine example.com\n", "http://example.com", None),
        ("Valid entry", "machine example.com login pass\n", "http://example.com", ("login", "pass")),
        ("Valid entry with account", "machine example.com login account pass\n", "http://example.com", ("login", "pass")),
        ("Wrong host", "machine other.com login pass\n", "http://example.com", None),
    ]

    for name, content, url, expected in cases:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False) as f:
            f.write(content)
            netrc_path = f.name

        os.environ["NETRC"] = netrc_path
        try:
            auth = get_netrc_auth(url)
            print(f"{name}: {auth!r} == {expected!r} -> {auth == expected}")
            assert auth == expected
        finally:
            del os.environ["NETRC"]
            os.unlink(netrc_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_netrc_cases()
